lines.text: The psalm calls for a new song to the LORD, because His right hand and holy arm gained Him the victory.
The LORD has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Jacob, and the ends of the earth have seen His salvation.
All the earth is called to make a joyful noise to the LORD, with the lyre and the harp.
With trumpets and cymbals people shout for joy before the LORD, the King, and the sea and all that fills it resound.
The rivers clap and the mountains sing before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth with righteousness.
